name: booking-fullstack-challenge
description: Booking Challenge full-stack — Angular + Express + MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @booking/backend" "npm run start -w @booking/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @booking/backend && npm run build -w @booking/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @booking/backend && npm run lint -w @booking/frontend
